blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas Youth women’s team lost to China by 63 points, 112-49, on Thursday in the qualification for the semifinals of the Fiba U18 Women’s Asia Cup 2026 Division A in Seremban, Malaysia. But despite the loss, the Gilas girls still have a shot at booking a place in the Fiba U19 Women’s Basketball World Cup 2027 to be held in Chengdu, China, in July 2027.
